g.text: 45 accepted cases · five seeds per format/budget · fixed 2,048-target LFM3 subset. Left error bars: conditional MC95 t4 intervals.
C1024 uses GB10; higher-budget K1 uses GB10 and K4/K8 use H100 with own-backend controls. Backend provenance is retained.
Logical counts assume full residency; scheduled work and temporal samples are not measured hardware energy or latency.
